gbif.description: GBIF Species API for taxonomic and occurrence data. No auth required. Used by audit-factual-accuracy and backfill scripts.

iucn.description: IUCN Red List API v3. Requires IUCN_TOKEN env var. Used by iucn-verifier subagent to validate conservation status.

powo.description: Plants of the World Online (Kew) — authoritative plant taxonomy. No auth required.

inaturalist.description: iNaturalist API for occurrence observations, photos, and taxonomic cross-references. No auth required for read operations; OAuth for posting observations.
